## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_土. Core element Metal, energy element Earth. Law: Earth feeds Metal (土生金: ore grows in the mountain). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Earth is this core's Mind.
- Family personas and ruled domains (the cost domain: the cost is named in these words or in ordinary life, work only where a domain word is work; the definition names one drive per persona, E8): The Alchemist: Learning, Intuition, Solitude · The Sage: Knowledge, Shelter, Nurture

The classical excess idiom for this cell (say it in English in carry.excess, never quote it): 金赖土生，土多金埋 (生之太过, the Mind door; 土多金埋 applies to 辛, 庚 reads 郁滞).
The eight wide openers (a carry.wide clause opens with one; no core repeats one across its wanted energies): "{Element} is one thing you never run short of" · "{Element} is easy for you to reach" · "{Element} is all around you" · "You have plenty of {Element}" · "{Element} is already here in plenty" · "You are well supplied with {Element}" · "You were given plenty of {Element}" · "There is no shortage of {Element} in you".
Fields shown above that are not the target are context for the repetition law (no four-word run shared with them) and for the cut law; do not rewrite them.

No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core, so no percentage, no band and no state of one chart appears in any value (the engine owns the numbers). The pole's band facts come from the pair law and the band table (REA_02 §5c): the catalyst pole of Earth as the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in), remedy verb Refill; the friction pole of Earth as the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels), remedy verb Channel, cure set Wood (the taming cure by the ten equations, template-level). The states this cell renders (chart.mjs, journeyData.js: the pole's turn, or the carry line for an absent, thin, abundant, dominant or unrooted energy): catalyst_turn, friction_turn, wide, missing, spared, thin, excess. The yin sibling's overrides (mechanism_yin, carry_yin) are not in this batch and keep the station's text.

mechanism.base.value: Metal is born of earth, the old texts say: it lies in the mountain, gathered in stone, grown by slow pressure and the moisture of deep ground. Nothing hurries it. The mountain holds the ore for ages before any edge is struck from it, and every blade remembers the patience of the rock that made it.

mechanism.catalyst_turn.value: Run thin, the mountain goes hungry: a keen edge with nothing behind it, sharpness spent faster than it forms. Your chart asks you to feed the ground. Rest and study are smelting, not stalling.

function.definition_catalyst.value: Earth is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is a slow, deep intake that turns experience into ground you can stand on. Books, mentors, quiet corners, long walks after hard conversations: whatever feeds it comes back later as judgment.

function.definition_friction.value: Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake with no off switch. Study, comfort, preparation, shelter: everything that goes in counts as progress, so nothing ever has to come out. Learning becomes the most respectable way to stand still.

spec.remedy_gloss: Refill: intake, rest, taking in (read, sit, sleep, ask, wait for the whole answer); never a push for more output (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the catalyst pole of the Mind is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), three or four, ending on the smallest, no aphorism close; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_catalyst.value: Deep minds underrate their own output, so build the habit of releasing some. Once a month, teach one thing you learned to one person, because explaining it is how you find out it is really yours. Keep one notebook instead of six. And say your slow answer out loud before someone faster says a worse one.

spec.remedy_gloss: Channel: an outlet, an action that spends the excess (make, ship, say, lift, walk, cut); never a brake (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the friction pole of the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), two, in the cure's register (owner 2026-10-14, Q35: on an Order cure someone above you, a deadline, a judge, never a friend; on a Mind cure study, shelter, time; on an Action cure a thing made or shipped; on a Body cure sleep, food, rest; on an Expression cure a thing said or given), the smallest action last, closing on the energy prescription in the energy-manual register (owner 2026-09-29, the beat re-cut 2026-09-30): "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy. {Element} {is or does, in its own material, two clauses}. Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The energy is the subject, a material the reader can hold and use, no life action inside the beat; the element must be in cure_set, never one that feeds this friction; the gate blocks without the "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy" form; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_friction.value: At some point more learning is just fear with a reading list. Trade study for evidence: for every hour that goes in, one small thing comes out where someone can see it. Give each research topic a decision date. Finish one old course before any new one gets your money.

spec.pole_neutral: one verdict per pair, rendered on this page whichever pole the chart shows (this batch writes both poles), so it must read true on both: what Earth as your Mind IS, never its state, no heavy, thin, too much, too little, running over, running short

cta_verdict.value: Your mind takes things in slowly and keeps them forever, and your best judgments are the ones you let sit overnight.
